title: Jump Game VI
problemStatement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer k. Starting from index 0, you may jump to any index in the range [i + 1, min(i + k, n - 1)]. The score of a path is the sum of all visited elements. Return the maximum possible score upon reaching the last index.
input: Integer n Array nums Integer k
output: A single integer representing the maximum score.
